last_decision.thesis: Conditional-watch thesis, no entry: the trend is intact (2026-10-16 close 343.46, RSI14 62.1, MACD positive, above SMA20/50/200, 20-session volatility 16.3% annualized, VIX 19.99 — not stressed) and filing-verified fundamentals are strong ex-one-off (Q3 FY26 revenue $109.4B +16.4%, diluted EPS $2.02 including a filing-confirmed $0.11 tariff-refund benefit and ~2pts gross margin from refunds, nine-month revenue +16%, operating income +21.7%, OCF $117B, falling debt). But the ~28% re-rating over 120 sessions embeds flawless ex-refund execution. The MD&A confirms new Section 301 tariffs and the open Section 232 semiconductor investigation as live FY27 cost risks, and the 10-Q risk factors document single-source component exposure with intensifying memory/NAND supply constraints. Entry activates only when the Oct 30 print verifies ex-refund organic margin, primary evidence separates Duo demand depth from the documented supply constraint, and the liability line decomposes benignly.
last_decision.countercase: The wait is not free: if the Oct 28 event confirms Duo sell-through with delivery pushouts and the Oct 30 print shows ex-refund gross margin still expanding with an inventory drawdown, the backlog smooths FY27 revenue recognition, converts the inventory build into fulfilled upside, and entry costs 5-8% more from the current ~342.8 area. Verified name-specific relative strength (AAPL +2.2%/20 sessions vs QQQ -1.5%, IWM -4.8%) with a 1.56x-volume up session reads as accumulation, not distribution; the 10/16 close sat mid-range near the upper Bollinger band, consistent with launch repositioning. ~22% underlying EPS growth, $117B nine-month OCF and continued buybacks (shares -2.6% YoY) historically defend 30x+ multiples, and a Fed path compressing the long end would remove the main multiple risk. Refunds could also recur if tariff policy shifts. A confirmed-demand print would invalidate the de-rating risk that anchors this hold.
last_decision.invalidation: This hold converts to a buy evaluation when specific source-backed evidence shows: (1) the Oct 30 FQ4 report demonstrates ex-refund organic revenue and gross-margin strength with benign refund-recurrence language in the new filings; (2) Apple-store ship dates or primary company statements confirm iPhone Duo demand depth rather than the filing-documented DRAM/NAND supply constraint; (3) the notes decompose the elevated other non-current liabilities line benignly rather than material accruals or legal exposure; and (4) price holds above the rising 20-day average through the print. It converts to a decisive avoid posture if Q4 shows refund roll-off against inventory write-down risk, the liability line contains material accruals, or price loses the 20-day and 50-day averages on widening breadth deterioration.

last_decision.thesis: Hold on SP500 is a portfolio-level decision, unchanged across four prior approved holds. Verified standing facts: Fed target 3.75-4.00% from a 12-0 hike (c4766cd2c8ccfd44), corroborated by readable FOMC minutes text noting inflation elevated, geopolitical energy pressure and the 'will deliver price stability' commitment (e4ca17945c0d6c56); BoE Bank Rate 3.75% (119ab1d3fbfe56ef) held 6-3 with three hike dissents, CPI 3.1% in August likely rising further, and inflation risks judged tilted upside (6c6b04263fe1e72b, 3257cb6a1f95a005); UK unemployment 4.9% May-Jul (f86574b608ca7c64); Brent $126.55 sustaining the energy-inflation channel (f0649cf2ac4fbbe7). The falsifiable question is unchanged: does the shared global-tightening factor keep compressing long-duration index multiples, or does range trade persist with intact labour and calm aggregate credit? The Oct 20 labour print is now delivered only via unverified BBC summaries (c1fb64abaf970055, 6406ed19b596a94d): headline joblessness easing but vacancies falling on small-firm hiring retrenchment — directionally consistent with soft labour conditions, which weakens the second-round hawkish branch rather than resolving either. The Oct 21 CPI print is the scheduled test that distinguishes an energy-only rise (escalation weakens) from verified second-round effects (escalation strengthens). The quote below both SMAs with a negative MACD histogram remains diagnostic of neither hypothesis. No order is warranted; any future conversion additionally requires fresh quotes, measured CFD costs and decomposed policy expectations.
last_decision.countercase: Strongest case against holding: the short-side branch is half-confirmed — the index sits below both SMAs with a negative MACD histogram, HY OAS has widened materially over 20 sessions while the Fed hikes and the BoE leans hawkish — so waiting through the Oct 21 CPI print forgoes trend if discount-rate compression accelerates. Strongest case against a short is equally concrete: Monday's rebound snapshots (QQQ +1.37%, MU +3.07%) cut against the stress narrative, HY near 3.31% remains historically tight, BBB near 1.06% and deeply loose NFCI show no systemic strain, and the committee established that VIX, HY OAS and Friday's heavy QQQ volume are one correlated cluster, not independent confirmations — shorting now risks expressing a single unresolved event. A third objection: today's BBC flow, if corroborated, already weakens the GBP second-round leg, so the shared-factor thesis is eroding and holding cash merely delays acknowledging that. That is precisely why no long is opened either — the softening-labour branch must be confirmed against the ONS release and tomorrow's CPI before any directional file exists. A flat GBP 1,500 demo book forgoes learning, but the mandate's patient-thesis requirement and a catalyst arriving within 24 hours outweigh that; a six-hour-plus hold is an ordinary minimum, never a timer.
last_decision.invalidation: Hold converts to a directional file only with specific source-backed resolution: (1) the Oct 21 UK CPI print — confirmed second-round wage/price effects escalate the global-tightening branch; an energy-only rise with soft labour weakens it and, if corroborated by the ONS labour detail behind today's BBC vacancy report (c1fb64abaf970055, 6406ed19b596a94d), narrows the short-side case; (2) HY OAS sustained above ~3.5-3.6% with continued high-volume breadth losses would justify researching a short index file; (3) the 10y below ~4.9% with HY back under ~3.0% and index volume normalising would close the rate-compression line and justify researching a long file; (4) readable OIS/SEP decomposition separating expected policy from term premium. New price levels alone resolve only pricing objections and never trigger trades. Any conversion requires fresh-session quotes, measured spread and a full holding-cost budget; the instrument is a price-only CFD with swap fields as metadata. Uncertified full-filing diligence may justify continued holding even where a directional thesis matures.
